## Context

- **Purpose**: one reference page for every metadata column on the <PROJECT> object, in the style of the <PROVIDER> report `<REPORT>`
  - Each column gets a name, category, data type, description and a live summary computed from the object
- **Two providers**:
  - **<PROVIDER> columns**: delivered with `read/objects/<OBJECT>.rds`, described with the text of `<REPORT>`
  - **<ANALYST> columns**: added by this project's numbered notebooks, detected as columns in a checkpoint that are absent from the delivered object
- **Independent of the pipeline**: the lettered name keeps this notebook outside the numbered chain
  - It reads checkpoints; no numbered notebook reads anything it writes
  - Re-render it whenever a numbered notebook writes a new checkpoint
- **Status**: `undocumented` (in an object, no description), `missing` (described, absent), `pending` (described, its notebook has not run yet)
- **Rendering**: `quarto render A-metadata-columns.qmd -M eval:true` from `scripts/`

## Checkpoints

| Stage | File | Description |
|-------------------|------------------|----------------------------------|
| Input | `../read/objects/<OBJECT>.rds` | <PROVIDER> delivery, read-only |
| Input | `../checkpoints/01-<NAME>.rds` | Columns added by 01 |
| Snapshot | `../checkpoints/A-metadata-snapshot.rds` | `meta.data` of every available object, rebuilt only when an input changes |
| Registry | `../write/tables/A-metadata-columns/A-metadata-columns.csv` | One row per column with status and live summary |

- **Conflicts**: `dplyr` verbs win

#| label: setup

  dplyr::first, dplyr::last, dplyr::desc, dplyr::lag,

  base::intersect, base::setdiff, base::union,

)

# Output directories ----------
dir.create("../checkpoints", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

dir.create("../write/tables/A-metadata-columns",
           recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

## Metadata Snapshot

- **One read per object**: read, keep `meta.data`, `rm()` + `gc()`, next object
- **Sources in pipeline order**: the first source holding a column is credited with adding it
  - A source that does not exist yet is skipped
- **Rebuild rule**: reuse the snapshot while the available sources and their modification times are unchanged
- **Adding a stage**: append one row to `sources`

```{r}
#| label: metadata-snapshot

# Libraries ----------
library(conflicted)
library(SeuratObject)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)

# Inputs ----------
sources <- tribble(
  ~stage,      ~notebook,           ~path,
  "delivered", "<PROVIDER> delivery", "../read/objects/<OBJECT>.rds",
  "01",        "01-<NAME>.qmd",     "../checkpoints/01-<NAME>.rds"
) |>
  mutate(exists = file.exists(path),
         modified = as.numeric(file.mtime(path)))

snapshot_path <- "../checkpoints/A-metadata-snapshot.rds"

# Metadata reader function ----------
read_metadata <- function(path) {
  seu <- read_rds(path)
  metadata <- as_tibble(seu[[]], rownames = ".cell")
  rm(seu)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
  metadata
}

# Processing ----------
if (!any(sources$exists)) stop("No source object exists; check the paths in `sources`")

snapshot_fresh <- file.exists(snapshot_path) &&
  identical(select(read_rds(snapshot_path)$sources, stage, exists, modified),
            select(sources, stage, exists, modified))

if (snapshot_fresh) {
  snapshot <- read_rds(snapshot_path)
} else {
  available <- filter(sources, exists)
  snapshot <- list(
    sources = sources,
    metadata = map(set_names(available$path, available$stage), read_metadata)
  )
}

snapshot_overview <- snapshot$sources |>
  mutate(cells = map_int(stage, \(s) if (s %in% names(snapshot$metadata)) nrow(snapshot$metadata[[s]]) else NA_integer_),
         columns = map_int(stage, \(s) if (s %in% names(snapshot$metadata)) ncol(snapshot$metadata[[s]]) - 1L else NA_integer_),
         modified = as.POSIXct(modified, origin = "1970-01-01")) |>
  select(stage, notebook, path, exists, cells, columns, modified)

# Outputs ----------
if (!snapshot_fresh) write_rds(snapshot, snapshot_path)

snapshot_overview
```

## Column Registry

- **<PROVIDER> descriptions**: transcribed from `<REPORT>`, wording kept, HTML dropped
  - `report_name_fixes` maps report names to the object's spelling, with the evidence
  - `provider_extra` describes delivered columns the report omits; marked as written here
- **<ANALYST> descriptions**: each names the notebook expected to add it, so a not-yet-run column reads `pending`
- **Families**: a prefix plus the expected member names; observed prefix matches are added too
- **Live summaries**: from the first source holding the column, following the declared type

```{r}
#| label: column-registry

# Libraries ----------
library(conflicted)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(knitr)

# Inputs ----------
snapshot <- read_rds("../checkpoints/A-metadata-snapshot.rds")

family_members <- character(0)   # e.g. names(read_rds("../checkpoints/02-gene-sets.rds"))

# Provider descriptions ----------
provider_registry <- tribble(
  ~name, ~category, ~type, ~description,
  "orig.ident", "Sample metadata", "categorical", "<description from the report>",
  "nCount_RNA", "QC metrics", "continuous", "<description from the report>"
) |>
  mutate(provider = "<PROVIDER>", added_in = "<PROVIDER> delivery", family = NA_character_,
         description_source = "<REPORT>", registry_note = NA_character_)

# Provider spelling fixes ----------
report_name_fixes <- tibble(report_name = character(), object_name = character(), evidence = character())
# |> add_row(report_name = "Cell_Subtype_X", object_name = "Cell_subtype_X", evidence = "same name apart from case")

provider_registry <- provider_registry |>
  left_join(report_name_fixes, by = c("name" = "report_name")) |>
  mutate(registry_note = if_else(is.na(object_name), registry_note,
                                 paste0("named `", name, "` in the provider report; ", evidence)),
         name = coalesce(object_name, name)) |>
  select(-object_name, -evidence)

# Delivered columns missing from the report ----------
provider_extra <- tibble(name = character(), category = character(), type = character(), description = character()) |>
  mutate(provider = "<PROVIDER>", added_in = "<PROVIDER> delivery", family = NA_character_,
         description_source = "this notebook",
         registry_note = "not in the provider report; description added here")

# Analyst descriptions ----------
analyst_registry <- tribble(
  ~name, ~category, ~type, ~added_in, ~description,
  "<new_column>", "Cell state & classification", "categorical", "01-<NAME>.qmd", "<what it holds and the rule that built it>"
) |>
  mutate(provider = "<ANALYST>", family = NA_character_)

# Analyst column families ----------
analyst_families <- tibble(family = character(), category = character(), type = character(),
                           added_in = character(), description = character())
# |> add_row(family = "SCORE_", category = "Signature scores", type = "continuous",
#             added_in = "02-<NAME>.qmd", description = "<method, input layer, normalisation>")

all_columns <- snapshot$metadata |>
  map(\(metadata) setdiff(names(metadata), ".cell")) |>
  reduce(union, .init = character(0))

family_registry <- analyst_families |>
  mutate(name = map(family, \(prefix) union(paste0(prefix, family_members),
                                            str_subset(all_columns, paste0("^", prefix))))) |>
  unnest(name) |>
  mutate(provider = "<ANALYST>")

described <- bind_rows(provider_registry, provider_extra, analyst_registry, family_registry) |>
  mutate(description_source = coalesce(description_source, "this notebook"))

# Column detection ----------
first_seen <- snapshot$metadata |>
  imap(\(metadata, stage) tibble(name = setdiff(names(metadata), ".cell"), stage = stage)) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  distinct(name, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  left_join(select(snapshot$sources, stage, notebook), by = "stage")

latest_stage <- last(names(snapshot$metadata))
latest_columns <- setdiff(names(snapshot$metadata[[latest_stage]]), ".cell")

# Live summary function ----------
empty_summary <- tibble(class = NA_character_, n_cells = NA_integer_, n_na = NA_integer_,
                        n_levels = NA_integer_, top_levels = NA_character_,
                        min = NA_real_, median = NA_real_, max = NA_real_)

summarise_column <- function(values, type) {
  base <- tibble(class = class(values)[1], n_cells = length(values), n_na = sum(is.na(values)))
  if (type == "continuous" && is.numeric(values)) {
    finite <- values[is.finite(values)]
    mutate(base, n_levels = NA_integer_, top_levels = NA_character_,
           min = if (length(finite)) min(finite) else NA_real_,
           median = if (length(finite)) median(finite) else NA_real_,
           max = if (length(finite)) max(finite) else NA_real_)
  } else {
    level_counts <- sort(table(values, useNA = "no"), decreasing = TRUE)
    top <- head(level_counts, 3)
    mutate(base, n_levels = length(level_counts),
           top_levels = if (length(level_counts) > 1 && all(level_counts == 1)) {
             "every value unique"
           } else {
             paste0(names(top), " (", format(as.integer(top), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE), ")",
                    collapse = "; ")
           },
           min = NA_real_, median = NA_real_, max = NA_real_)
  }
}

# Registry ----------
available_notebooks <- snapshot$sources |>
  filter(exists) |>
  pull(notebook)

undocumented <- first_seen |>
  filter(!name %in% described$name) |>
  mutate(type = map2_chr(name, stage, \(column, stage) {
    if (is.numeric(snapshot$metadata[[stage]][[column]])) "continuous" else "categorical"
  })) |>
  transmute(name, type, provider = if_else(stage == "delivered", "<PROVIDER>", "<ANALYST>"),
            category = "Unassigned", family = NA_character_, description = NA_character_,
            description_source = NA_character_)

registry <- bind_rows(described, undocumented) |>
  left_join(first_seen, by = "name") |>
  mutate(summary = pmap(list(name, stage, type), \(column, stage, type) {
    if (is.na(stage)) empty_summary else summarise_column(snapshot$metadata[[stage]][[column]], type)
  })) |>
  unnest(summary) |>
  mutate(
    present = !is.na(notebook),
    added_in = coalesce(notebook, added_in),
    in_latest = name %in% latest_columns,
    status = case_when(
      is.na(description) ~ "undocumented",
      present ~ "documented",
      !added_in %in% available_notebooks ~ "pending",
      .default = "missing"
    ),
    note = case_when(
      status == "undocumented" ~ "type inferred from class",
      present & type == "continuous" & !class %in% c("numeric", "integer") ~ paste("described continuous but stored as", class),
      provider == "<PROVIDER>" & present & !in_latest ~ paste("dropped before", latest_stage),
      .default = registry_note
    )
  ) |>
  select(provider, name, family, category, type, description, description_source, added_in,
         status, present, in_latest, class, n_cells, n_na, n_levels, top_levels,
         min, median, max, note)

registry_counts <- registry |>
  count(provider, status) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

# Outputs ----------
write_csv(registry, "../write/tables/A-metadata-columns/A-metadata-columns.csv", na = "")

kable(registry_counts, caption = "Columns per provider and status")
```

## <PROVIDER> Columns

- **Source**: every column in the `meta.data` of `read/objects/<OBJECT>.rds`
- **Summaries**: computed on the delivered object

```{r}
#| label: provider-cards
#| output: asis

# Libraries ----------
library(conflicted)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# Inputs ----------
registry <- read_csv("../write/tables/A-metadata-columns/A-metadata-columns.csv",
                     col_types = cols(.default = col_character(),
                                      present = col_logical(), in_latest = col_logical(),
                                      n_cells = col_double(), n_na = col_double(),
                                      n_levels = col_double(), min = col_double(),
                                      median = col_double(), max = col_double()))

# Processing ----------
provider_cards <- registry |>
  filter(provider == "<PROVIDER>") |>
  render_metadata_cards(supplier = "<PROVIDER>")

# Outputs ----------
cat(provider_cards)
```

## <ANALYST> Columns

- **Source**: columns in a numbered checkpoint that are absent from the delivered object
  - The pill on each card names the notebook whose checkpoint first holds the column

```{r}
#| label: analyst-cards
#| output: asis

# Libraries ----------
library(conflicted)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# Inputs ----------
registry <- read_csv("../write/tables/A-metadata-columns/A-metadata-columns.csv",
                     col_types = cols(.default = col_character(),
                                      present = col_logical(), in_latest = col_logical(),
                                      n_cells = col_double(), n_na = col_double(),
                                      n_levels = col_double(), min = col_double(),
                                      median = col_double(), max = col_double()))

# Processing ----------
analyst_cards <- registry |>
  filter(provider == "<ANALYST>") |>
  render_metadata_cards()

# Outputs ----------
cat(analyst_cards)
```

## Registry Checks

- **Undocumented**: add a registry row
- **Missing**: the column was renamed or dropped upstream; fix or remove its row
- **Pending**: re-render after the named notebook writes its checkpoint
- **Notes**: documented rows that deviate from the provider report, kept visible

```{r}
#| label: registry-checks

# Libraries ----------
library(conflicted)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

# Inputs ----------
registry <- read_csv("../write/tables/A-metadata-columns/A-metadata-columns.csv",
                     col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))

# Processing ----------
flagged <- registry |>
  filter(status != "documented" | !is.na(note)) |>
  mutate(group = coalesce(family, name)) |>
  group_by(provider, group, status, added_in, note) |>
  summarise(columns = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(provider, status, group)

# Outputs ----------
if (nrow(flagged) == 0) {
  cat("Every column is documented and present.\n")
} else {
  kable(flagged, caption = "Flagged columns and deviations from the provider report (families collapsed to one row)")
}
```
